  AGENDA
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  September 16, 2019

11:30 a.m. – Small Executive Conference, 9th Floor

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the August 26, 2019, meeting.

  2. Leonca Cahee – Executive session to discuss recommended reimbursement to Leonca
  Cahee for supplies purchased for the City’s Annual employee Service Award Ceremony.

  3. Sculpture Conservation Studio – Executive session to discuss recommending payment
  for repair of sculpture and maintenance of the artwork located at Grevillea Art Park.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

  Adjournment.

City of Inglewood

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  September 16, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Council Chambers, 9th floor at
11:50 a.m.:

  Members Present: Aisha Thompson, City Clerk Department
  Wanda Brown, Treasure’s Department
  Ken Campos, City Attorney Department
  Maria Heaney, Finance Department

  Staff Present:  Jose Cortes, Human Resources Director
  Sabrina Barnes, Parks and Recreation Director

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Member Heaney reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of August 26, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Leonca Cahee – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  reimbursement for $405.00. Motion carried unanimously.

  3. Sculpture Conservation Studio – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the
  recommended payment for the repair of sculpture and maintenance in the amount of
  $3,475.00. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Member Heaney reported no public comments.

  There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 12:01 p.m.

Adjournment
